name: Teixeirinha
description: '''Teixeirinha''' (March 3, 1927 - December 4, 1985), given name Vitor Mateus Teixeira, was a Brazilian [[musician]]. A best-selling artist, Teixeirinha holds several records, such as the first artist to sell one million copies of a disc containing a single song, [[Coração de Luto]]. Teixeirinha also holds the record for most songs recorded in Brazil, being 758 across over 50 albums. He also composed exactly 1,200 songs. He was popular worldwide, particularly in Europe and Africa.
